sermon.title: The Any Minute Return of Jesus Christ— October 4, 2020
sermon.speaker: Pastor David G. Kincer
sermon.summary: Pastor David G. Kincer presents the “any-minute return” as the fifth doctrine that takes the fight out of Christians. No one knows the day, yet date-setters from William Miller to modern preachers have failed. Christ will present a glorious church first, and the wicked are taken first. Believers must execute righteousness and rescue the oppressed.
sermon.transcript_source: This transcript comes from YouTube’s automatic English captions, which supply the timing and the words. Punctuation, capitalization and paragraphing were added from the speaker’s pauses and then corrected by hand, and obvious caption errors (names, Bible references) were fixed; his wording was not rewritten. “[unclear]” marks a word or name that was not clear.
